_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Mchezaji Snake kwenye {width}×{height} grid.
Unadhibiti nyoka {player_id}. Harakati halali: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (au w/s/a/d).
Lengo: kuishi muda mrefu zaidi au kuwa mrefu zaidi na kupata alama ya juu zaidi (kikomo cha mzunguko {max_turns} mizunguko).

game_action.invalid_death: Njoka {player_id} nĩ akuire tondũ wa kũgũrũka na njĩra ĩtarĩ ya kĩhooto.

outcome.survived_win: Mũteng'eri {player_id} nĩ aahonokire; arĩa angĩ othe magĩkua.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Njoka ciothe ciakuire o hĩndĩ ĩmwe.
outcome.outlived: Mũgambo ũcio nĩ waatũũrire gũkĩra ũrĩa ũngĩ wothe.
outcome.turn_limit: Turn limit reached - best score wins tie-break.
